# PrimeVue AutoImportResolver

Resolver plugin for `unplugin-vue-components` that auto-imports PrimeVue components and directives. Components used in templates are resolved and imported at build time, no manual import statements needed.

## Setup

```ts
// vite.config.ts
import Components from 'unplugin-vue-components/vite';
import { PrimeVueResolver } from '@primevue/auto-import-resolver';

export default defineConfig({
    plugins: [
        Components({
            resolvers: [PrimeVueResolver()]
        })
    ]
});
```

After this, components work in templates without imports:

```vue
<template>
    <Button label="Save" />
    <DataTable :value="rows">
        <Column field="name" header="Name" />
    </DataTable>
</template>
```

## Options

```ts
PrimeVueResolver({
    // Only resolve components that match this prefix (e.g. <p-button>)
    components: { prefix: 'p' },

    // Custom import path override
    resolve: (meta, type) => {
        if (meta.name === 'Button') return { from: 'my-button-override' };
    }
});
```

Directives are resolved automatically as well (`v-tooltip`, `v-ripple`, `v-badge`, etc.).
